title: Friction direction
description: Essential: Student correctly identifies the static friction force on the lower surface of D points to the right, opposing the tendency of motion.

title: Normal force magnitude
description: Essential: Student provides the correct expression for the normal force N = 2kx/(1 - 2√3μ - μ²).

title: Minimum μ condition
description: Essential: Student states that self-locking requires the denominator to be zero, leading to μ_min = 2 - √3 ≈ 0.27.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Student sets up correct force balance equations for latch D in both horizontal and vertical directions.

title: Friction force expressions
description: Important: Student correctly expresses both friction forces (f₁ and f₂) in terms of normal forces and μ.

title: Spring force inclusion
description: Important: Student includes the spring force kx in the force balance equations.

title: Geometry/trigonometry
description: Optional: Student correctly resolves forces along the inclined surface using θ = 30°.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Student makes sign errors when resolving forces along the inclined surface or in force balance equations.

title: Incorrect friction direction
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns the direction of friction forces (e.g., left instead of right for lower surface).

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic errors when solving simultaneous equations for N or μ_min.
